chunks: When the oceans are poured forth
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the seas are 'poured forth' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'pouring out' of the seas (fujjirat) is interpreted not merely as a physical mixing of waters but as the removal of the barriers that separate the realms of the living and the dead, facilitating the gathering of souls. This cosmic upheaval is often linked to the concept of *Barzakh* being lifted, marking the transition from the intermediate world to the final accountability before Allah. The imagery underscores the absolute power of God to dismantle natural laws as a precursor to the resurrection of all beings.
